Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 실패한 만큼 보충하고 싶어 한다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> wants to make up for the failure with extra training. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は失敗した分だけ補いたいと思っている。何と声をかけようか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>想为自己的失败做点补偿。该说什么好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>想為自己的失敗做點補償。該說什麼好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> veut compenser son échec par un entraînement supplémentaire. Que devrais-je dire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> möchte ihr Versagen durch zusätzliches Training wettmachen. Was soll ich sagen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quiere compensar su error con entrenamiento extra. ¿Qué debería decir?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quer compensar o fracasso com treino extra. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> อยากฝึกเพิ่มเพื่อชดเชยความผิดพลาด ควรพูดว่าอะไรดีคะ?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ingin menebus kegagalannya dengan latihan tambahan. Apa yang harus kukatakan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> muốn bù đắp cho thất bại bằng cách luyện tập thêm. Tôi nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अतिरिक्त प्रशिक्षण से अपनी गलती सुधारना चाहता/चाहती है। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Don't push yourself. You'll get hurt. Let's stop here.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 無理して怪我するよ。やめよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 太勉强会受伤的，别练了。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 太勉強會受傷的，別練了。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Ne te surmène pas. Tu vas te blesser. Arrêtons-nous là.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Überanstrengen Sie sich nicht, sonst verletzen Sie sich. Hören wir auf.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No te esfuerces demasiado. Te lastimarás. Detengámonos aquí.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Não se esforce demais. Você vai se machucar. Vamos parar por aqui.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: อย่าฝืนตัวเองเลยค่ะ เดี๋ยวจะบาดเจ็บได้ พักก่อนดีกว่าค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Jangan memaksakan diri. Kamu akan terluka. Mari berhenti di sini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đừng ép bản thân quá. Cậu sẽ bị thương đấy. Chúng ta dừng lại ở đây thôi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: खुद पर ज़्यादा ज़ोर मत डालो। तुम्हें चोट लग जाएगी। यहीं रुकते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: …คุณจะโอเคจริง ๆ เหรอคะ?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ยื่นยาเพิ่มพลังให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa cho cậu ấy một Bình Thuốc Sức Sống.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió detener el entrenamiento y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treino e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk menghentikan latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định dừng luyện tập và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण रोकने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'il/elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours avoir un goût d'inachevé.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschloss, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจนัก
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Mặc dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रहा/रही था।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y obtuvo resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e alcançou resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> พยายามอีกครั้งและทำได้สำเร็จ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi dan mencapai hasil yang solid.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại và đạt được kết quả khả quan.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम हासिल किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber noch einmal.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero volvió a fallar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> พยายามอีกครั้งแต่ก็ยังล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại nhưng lại thất bại một lần nữa.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रहा/रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a montré de la joie après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ดีใจที่ได้รับโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã vui vẻ hơn sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
